<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="1Y8CYGsFtqOjO_dqIdgi"> <mxGraphModel dx="10940" dy="5970" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 %% Initial Inputs
 Start([BEGIN]) --> InName[/INPUT patientsName/]
 InName --> InAge[/INPUT patientsAge/]
 InAge --> InType[/INPUT patientType/]
 InType --> InReason[/INPUT reasonForVisit/]

 %% Main Branch Decision
 InReason --> CheckBtn{ButtonClicked}

 %% Branch 1: ADD TO QUEUE
 CheckBtn -- \"ADD TO QUEUE\" --> CheckName{patientsName = \"\"}
 
 %% Validation Checks
 CheckName -- Yes --> ErrName[/OUTPUT \"Invalid: Patient name is required\"/] --> End([END])
 CheckName -- No --> CheckAge{patientsAge < 0 OR<br/>patientsAge > 120}
 
 CheckAge -- Yes --> ErrAge[/OUTPUT \"Invalid: Patient age must be between 0 to 120\"/] --> End
 CheckAge -- No --> CheckReason{reasonForVisit = \"\"}
 
 CheckReason -- Yes --> ErrReason[/OUTPUT \"Invalid: Reason for visit is required\"/] --> End
 CheckReason -- No --> CheckType{patientType = \"\"}
 
 CheckType -- Yes --> ErrType[/OUTPUT \"Invalid: Patient type is required\"/] --> End
 
 %% Priority Logic
 CheckType -- No --> CheckEmergency{patientType =<br/>\"Emergency\"}
 
 CheckEmergency -- Yes --> SetEmerg[Priority = \"EMERGENCY\"]
 CheckEmergency -- No --> CheckSenior{patientType =<br/>\"Senior\"}
 
 CheckSenior -- Yes --> SetSenior[Priority = \"SENIOR PRIORITY\"]
 CheckSenior -- No --> CheckPreg{patientType =<br/>\"Pregnant\"}
 
 CheckPreg -- Yes --> SetPreg[Priority = \"PRIORITY\"]
 CheckPreg -- No --> CheckReg{patientType =<br/>\"Regular\"}
 
 CheckReg -- Yes --> SetReg[Priority = \"REGULAR\"]
 CheckReg -- No --> GenQueue
 
 SetEmerg --> GenQueue
 SetSenior --> GenQueue
 SetPreg --> GenQueue
 SetReg --> GenQueue
 
 %% Output & Queue Increment
 GenQueue[QueueNumber = \"Q\" + FORMAT QueueCounter, \"000\"] --> OutQueue[/OUTPUT QueueNumber/]
 OutQueue --> OutType[/OUTPUT patientType/]
 OutType --> OutPriority[/OUTPUT Priority/]
 OutPriority --> IncCounter[QueueCounter = QueueCounter + 1]
 IncCounter --> End

 %% Branch 2: CLEAR
 CheckBtn -- \"CLEAR\" --> ClrName[CLEAR patientsName]
 ClrName --> ClrAge[CLEAR patientsAge]
 ClrAge --> ClrType[CLEAR patientType]
 ClrType --> ClrReason[CLEAR reasonForVisit]
 ClrReason --> ClrQNum[CLEAR QueueNumber]
 ClrQNum --> ClrOutType[CLEAR patientType OUTPUT]
 ClrOutType --> ClrOutPriority[CLEAR Priority OUTPUT]
 ClrOutPriority --> End

 %% Default Path (Other buttons)
 CheckBtn -- Other --> End",
 "config": null
